comment: The Big Secret of a Small Town. Installs dgvoodoo2, changes Resolution=max to unforced in dgvoodoo.conf, and uses dgVoodoo's d3d9 as d3d9.dll. The upstream sed address /[DirectX]/ is a character class that matches every Resolution line, so the edit is: first "max" on each line that contains "Resolution".
confidence: medium: depends on the dgvoodoo2 verb putting dgvoodoo.conf and dgd3d9.dll in syswow64
